Name: Gima Eisaku
Short Description: A 26-year-old ex-Cipher agent from Lumiose City now working with Snagem to recover his lost memories.
History: Gima grew up in Lumiose City during a period when the Kalosian government, under Team Flare's control, restricted passage through the region. He escaped the city and joined Cipher, where he developed romantic feelings for a superior named Lorvina. Hoping to impress her, he volunteered for experiments in Eins's laboratory, which — with the involvement of a Beheeyem — cost him his memories of his time in Cipher and his past. He now works with Snagem to recover his lost memories and to stop the shadow virus affecting Pokemon.

Name: Kalani
Short Description: A selfish, pretentious 14-year-old scion of Alolan royalty who covets power, money, and Legendary Pokemon.
History: Kalani hails from Alolan royalty on Ula Ula Island. He is characterized as a "Royal Pain," selfish and pretentious, loving power, money, and Legendary Pokemon while dismissing weaklings, weak Pokemon, and other royalty. His full backstory was listed as "under construction" in the profile.

Name: Geoffrey Meuller
Short Description: A helpful but abrasive 26-year-old battle strategist from Snowpoint City, partnered with a Mawile named Rachen.
History: Geoffrey grew up in Snowpoint City in the Sinnoh region but left home seeking something more than ice and snow all year. Though typically helpful and strategically skilled in battle, his abrasive exterior makes him hard to trust and he has a bit of a temper. He travels with a female Mawile nicknamed Rachen.

Name: Morgan Dulac
Short Description: A weathered 24-year-old drifter from Lavender Town with a good heart and a strong sense of justice, serving as a Snagem Scout.
History: Morgan is a lifelong wanderer who stowed away on a ship as a youth and has lived as a drifter ever since. His extensive travels made him worldly and accepting of diverse viewpoints, and he picked up survival skills, tracking ability, the knack of mimicking flying Pokemon calls, and street-honed hand-to-hand combat. Despite his rugged background he keeps strong moral principles, prefers diplomacy, and has a well-developed sense of justice that frequently complicates his life. He currently serves as a Tier 5 Snagem Scout.

Name: Arkelos Fyrestone
Character Species: Human (afflicted by a curse causing periodic canine-like transformation of hands and feet)
Short Description: A bright but volatile 29-year-old trainer from Lavaridge Town, marked by an unexplained canine curse from Mt. Pyre.
History: Arkelos grew up in Hoenn with traveling parents and was inspired to become a trainer after meeting Champion Alder in Unova, beginning his journey at age 13 with a fondness for Mt. Pyre and Mt. Chimney. Research at Mt. Pyre triggered nightmares and revealed a curse on him, requiring psychic intervention. At 17, his cherished partner Poochyena sacrificed itself to save him, devastating Arkelos. He left Hoenn for five years of travel across the regions before joining an organization in search of answers.

Name: Jezebel Pyrewood
Short Description: A tall, cheerful 20-year-old cook from a nomadic Kalos caravan, partnered with a rare silver-tailed Vulpix.
History: Born into a nomadic caravan of Kalos Gypsies, Jezebel began a culinary apprenticeship at age 8 — the youngest in her group — excelling at experimental dishes and foraging rare ingredients from the Laverre Nature Trail, and keeping detailed journals of areas, Pokemon, and plants. Her caravan became renowned in Lumiose City for its exotic trade goods. At 17, during the Harvest Festival succession ceremony, the egg she selected did not make her the chosen Fire Channeler successor. Devastated, she fled to an alley, where her egg hatched into a unique silver-tailed Vulpix — an unexpected gift that redeemed her disappointment.

Name: Chiasa "Chi" Addams
Short Description: A cynical but fiercely protective 17-year-old Channeler from Driftveil City's markets who ran from trouble at home into the ranks of a shady team.
History: Chiasa was born in March to merchant parents Erin and William Addams and grew up with four siblings in the market city of Driftveil, Unova. As a youth she caused trouble stealing from market stands, and after messing with the wrong people and facing possible police involvement, she fled rather than return home. Seeking a more exciting life, she followed rumors of a team of people up to no good and joined them, bringing along a Cranidos she had caught during her stealing days. She is cynical, quiet, observant, affectionate, protective, honest, and trusting, and would give her life for her loyal Pokemon companions.

Name: Blizzard
Short Description: A 33-year-old Articuno hybrid and former apprentice of Gym Leader Pryce, a strategic jack-of-all-trades frontline leader.
History: Originally a human apprentice to Pryce, the Mahogany Gym Leader, Blizzard was kidnapped by a deity-like being named Celcius and forcibly transformed into an Articuno hybrid, devastating surrounding regions with ice attacks while under its control. After regaining autonomy he struggled with guilt until an ambitious woman named Freth arrived pursuing Celcius; their conflicts escalated across regions as he learned to control his hybrid abilities. When Celcius captured and forcibly transformed Freth, Blizzard defeated Celcius and saved her at nearly the cost of his life. He resumed his gym apprenticeship while Freth worked toward redemption, and the two grew romantically close. Later he rescued an orphaned Vulpix hybrid, became entangled in a conspiracy involving the Pokemon Rangers, and joined Snagem to combat authoritarian threats to his region.

Name: Freth
Short Description: A 33-year-old Galarian Articuno hybrid and reformed crime boss, now a caring but fierce member of Blizzard's family and Snagem.
History: Freth inherited a criminal organization from her assassinated father and expanded its influence, identifying the ice elemental deity Celcius as the key to unprecedented power. Her ambitions collapsed when she encountered Blizzard, an Articuno hybrid determined to stop her; after months of escalating confrontations, Celcius captured her and forcibly transformed her into a hybrid pawn. Blizzard's victory over Celcius freed her, but her gang abandoned her, and with ranger interference and hybrid discrimination blocking legitimate work, she sought Blizzard's help. He reluctantly took her in with community service at the gym, where she softened, earned his trust, became part of his family, and developed romantic feelings for him. When Snagem formed to combat the Rangers, she contributed her criminal underworld knowledge and combat skills to defeat the Rangers and later threats.

Name: Tristen
Short Description: A kind-hearted, naive 13-year-old Manectric hybrid rescued from a brutal tribe and raised by Blizzard and Freth.
History: Tristen was kidnapped from his biological parents by a primitive hybrid tribe and endured years of torturous conditioning before being rescued by the people who became his brother and father. Blizzard trained him physically and in Pokemon battling while Freth taught him reading, writing, history, and mathematics; he found he preferred academics but stayed committed to training to protect his adopted home. Exceptionally kind but poor with social nuance and sarcasm, he still sees ethics in black-and-white terms. During the assault on Realgam Tower he harnessed the powerful Zapdos Heart despite inadequate capacity, unleashing a devastating electrical attack that put him into a coma but triggered his premature evolution into a Manectric hybrid. He remains physically weaker than experienced hybrids, relying on intelligence and his Pokemon allies.

Name: Ulla Hanabi
Short Description: A brave 10-year-old Fairy Channeler from Iki Town on a quest to save her Shadow-corrupted best friend Riolu.
History: Ulla grew up surrounded by Pokemon in Iki Town. At age 8 she defended an injured Riolu from wild attackers with only a stick, forging an unbreakable bond; the two exchanged matching necklaces and vowed to adventure together once she turned ten, and a curious Rowlet joined their circle. When suspicious strangers appeared in Iki Town, she found Rowlet wounded and Riolu converted into a Shadow Pokemon by the mysterious men. On her tenth birthday she chose Rowlet as her starter and set out to find her best friend, discovering Riolu at a robbed Pokemon Center, where he partially broke free of his shadow state to protect them. Team Snagem then recruited her to purge the darkness from Riolu and prevent similar incidents.

Name: Leon Hanabi
Short Description: Ulla's laid-back 20-year-old older brother, a Poison Channeler who raised her after their parents' deaths.
History: Leon, Ulla's older brother, was a relaxed child who liked napping in meadows, where his longtime companion Budew found him; when it evolved into Roselia it grew energetic and pushed him toward greater activity. The siblings lost their parents when Leon was 10 and Ulla was an infant, forcing them to move in with their grandparents, and Leon became Ulla's primary caregiver until she was 6, when he left on his own Pokemon journey with Roselia, gifting her their mother's cherished necklace before departing. He won numerous gym battles during his travels but never pursued championship status, regularly returning home to visit Ulla and their parents' grave.

Name: Sol
Hometown: Originally from Paldea; later Pyrite Town and Agate Village, Orre
Short Description: A 65-year-old Ho-oh hybrid ex-mercenary and co-founder of the modern Snagem, fighting on the frontlines with sword and hybrid abilities.
History: Sol originated in Paldea before settling in Pyrite Town, where survival accustomed him to moral compromises including theft and mercenary work. Through a client named Sub he learned of a chimeric creature in need of rescue, which led him to co-found the modern iteration of Snagem alongside Sub. He attempted retirement in Agate Village — his wife is deceased and he has a son, Aden — but rejoined the team as circumstances demanded. He fights on the frontlines with swordplay combined with hybrid abilities and uses teleportation tricks via his Xatu for tactical advantage, alternating between active combat and nomadic travels.

Name: Aden
Short Description: Sol's curious, self-styled "cursed" 29-year-old hybrid son, a rear-support trainer with a strengthening Celebi connection.
History: Aden, Sol's son, inherited hybrid genetics from both parents and grew up curious and adventurous, though he sees himself as cursed by unusual events; for his safety, Sol arranged for Cera to accompany him on dangerous operations. Granted two family Pokemon, he set out on his own journey and, through involvement with the Ranger Union during corruption investigations, became one of Snagem's emerging recruits under Blizzard's mentorship. After obtaining his trainer license he challenged Johto's gym circuit, journeyed independently, and reunited with the team in Kalos. Frustration over his task competency prompted a departure to reassess his contributions, and through subsequent adventures his Celebi connection strengthened significantly, enabling him to assist team members during the first Ultimate Weapon firing.

Name: Amaranth
Character Species: Human, experimentally converted into a hybrid (from Sol's DNA); budding Flying Channeler
Short Description: An amnesiac woman created from Sol's DNA in Ein's experiments, now a quiet, wind-attuned support member of Snagem.
History: An amnesiac initially believed to be Sol's opposite-gender clone, Amaranth was in truth the product of Ein's experiments using Sol's DNA, converted into a hybrid designed as sustenance for another experimental creature and as an immortal vessel for Ein himself. During a confrontation with Sol in Black City, her control chip burned away in her death and resurrection; recovered from Mt. Battle, she was brought to Snagem by Sol for rehabilitation. Despite inexperience as a hybrid, she shows strong wind attunement that persists through multiple resurrections, and her involvement with the team helped her reconstruct her identity. As a budding Flying Channeler she prioritizes support roles while maintaining a quiet reserve.

Name: Cera
Character Species: Mew (formerly chimeric, infused with Celebi and Jirachi DNA, later extracted)
Short Description: A childlike but protective Mew, once "Subject: Origin" of Project Genesis, rescued from Ein's lab and raised as family by Snagem.
History: Originally designated "Subject: Origin" in Project Genesis (which created XD002: Shadow Mewtwo), Cera was captured by Team Rocket, smuggled into Orre, and given to Ein for experimentation until Sub and Sol rescued her from the Citadark Isle laboratory. She existed in a chimeric form infused with Celebi and Jirachi DNA and was raised more as family than Pokemon, rarely entering Poke Balls; after a rescue in Kalos, Sub captured her with a Master Ball under team ownership via the GRAY system. She briefly pursued Ranger Union membership during the fight against internal corruption before defecting to independence and eventually surrendering her Capture Styler. Foreign DNA extraction after a Deoxys incident restored her balance but eliminated her hybrid abilities, though she gained enhanced energy detection; encouraged by the team in Alola, she grew in confidence and defeated XD002 in the Fairy Realm. Uniquely immune to the Shadow Virus (alongside Clear Body Pokemon), her DNA proved instrumental in vaccine development.

Name: DeoLux
Short Description: A hulking but shy 28-year-old shiny Luxray hybrid, former Sandgem police captain turned Snagem's team cook.
History: DeoLux was originally a human programmer and Captain at the Sandgem Police Department. He was mysteriously knocked unconscious and awoke transformed into a shiny Luxray hybrid; after breaking free violently, he fled Sandgem by boat. Upon joining Team Snagem he found greater camaraderie than in his hometown, developed skills beyond violence, and became the team cook, forming bonds with his Pokemon team and a Yamper hybrid companion he considers emotional support. Despite his formidable 7-foot, 344-pound muscular frame, he is inherently shy, enjoys cooking, working out, and learning, and values doing what is right while disliking chaos and arrogance.

Name: Veronica Nova
Short Description: A 21-year-old Snagem member from Pallet Town who was transformed into a Sableye hybrid by a curse, with purple-scaled skin, gems on her body, and crystallized pink eyes.
History: Veronica grew up in Pallet Town with her mother and brother; her brother left for the military when she was 8, and her mother died when she was 11. After a failed romantic relationship at 15 she left town seeking purpose and joined Snagem, where she received her first Pokemon, a Chimchar named Chi. During missions she encountered her estranged father and her imprisoned brother. On a Halloween mission in Lavender Town at age 20, a Sableye curse transformed her into a hybrid; after months of depression and summoning Uxie, the Sableye killed her and took the place of her heart in order to exist physically.

Name: Brian "Flint" Adams
Short Description: A 19-year-old breeder's son from Littleroot Town with an uncanny gift for calming fearful Pokemon, who joined Team Snagem to fight Shadow Pokemon.
History: Brian was born and raised in Littleroot Town by his parents Allison, a former Coordinator, and Ben, a former League challenger, who became renowned breeders; he learned breeding from his father and was partly raised by his mother's Lucario, Abby. At age five he showed an unusual ability to calm fearful Pokemon, notably a timid Poochyena. At fifteen he found an injured Lucario in the forest, and months later the now-evolved Mightyena led him to an abandoned egg, which hatched into the Riolu he raised as Lu, forming an exceptionally strong bond. After learning of Shadow Pokemon and Team Snagem's opposition to them, he joined the organization at nineteen, unaware his friend Amber Jacobs had also enlisted.

Name: Amber Jacobs
Short Description: A 23-year-old Snagem member from Littleroot Town who survived an abusive childhood and was transformed into a Froslass hybrid after nearly freezing to death in a Snowpoint blizzard.
History: Amber was raised by her father James after her mother died when she was thirteen; he was an abusive alcoholic, and she survived by learning his patterns and hiding in her mother's closet. At age ten she fled home to begin her Pokemon journey, rescuing an abandoned injured Eevee, Rainer, who recovered at the Professor's lab and chose to join her. At 21 she captured an abused Shuppet named Spooky, who initially attacked her and left scars before she earned his trust. At twenty-two she joined Team Snagem after hearing about Shadow Pokemon. On a recent mission in Snowpoint City, Sinnoh, she was lost in a blizzard and dying of cold when a Froslass saved her life by sharing energy, transforming her into a hybrid; the Froslass joined her team.

Name: Evelyn "Rachel" Sanchez
Short Description: A 22-year-old survivor from Celestic Town who overcame an abusive home and a tragic accident, later proving herself to Team Snagem during a Titan expedition in Paldea.
History: Evelyn was raised by her angry, alcoholic father after her mother died, developing hypervigilance and hiding in her mother's closet for safety. At age ten she fled toward the Professor's lab with her father in pursuit, escaping into the forest where she found a severely injured non-native Eevee; it recovered at the lab and the Eevee, Rainer, chose to join her journey. At sixteen her close friend Cindy died in a car crash while they were traveling to Snowpoint City, and Evelyn's broken leg left her with a slight limp; she withdrew from society until age twenty. She then joined the Academy in Paldea, took part in a Titan expedition alongside Snagem members, and rescued Brian Adams during the mission, impressing him enough to recommend her to Team Snagem's leadership.

Name: Daniel Nakamura
Hometown: Ecruteak City, Johto (born in Blackthorn City)
Short Description: An 18-year-old sword-trained former vigilante from Ecruteak City (nicknamed Dan or "Danny boy") who joined Team Snagem and searches for his absent father.
History: Daniel was born in Blackthorn City to a Dragon-specialist father and a mother who was a retired Kimono Girl. When he was 10 his father abandoned the family, and he and his mother moved to Ecruteak City to live with his grandfather Kin, a Bell Tower monk, while his mother worked as a Dance Hall waitress. Largely unsupervised, he grew angry and rebellious by 12, fighting local gangs to protect his mother, until his other grandfather, Gin, taught him swordsmanship to channel his rage. He secretly acted as a town vigilante and saved a young girl named Alex from thieves. Around age 16 he joined Team Snagem for income, initially thinking it a simple gang; the experience reconnected him with Dragon-type Pokemon and strengthened his bond with Alex, who later joined the organization too.

Name: Alexandra Suzuki
Short Description: An 11-year-old girl from Ecruteak City (nicknamed Alex) who was saved from thieves by Daniel Nakamura and later joined Team Snagem.
History: (Backstory section left empty/incomplete in the profile.)

Name: Connor Knight
Short Description: A 16-year-old boy from Veilstone City.
History: (Backstory section left empty/incomplete in the profile.)

Name: Unnamed (WIP)
Short Description: Incomplete placeholder profile with blank fields.

Name: Arwan
Hometown: Lilycobe [as written in profile; likely Lilycove]
Short Description: A tall, bearded 23-year-old from Lilycove who nursed an injured Lunatone back to health and now seeks adventure with it.
History: During a meteor shower, a badly injured Lunatone fell into Arwan's yard; he rushed to the local Poke Mart for potions and treated its wounds. Recognizing that its distinctive blue eyes would make it a target for hunters after its value, he chose to shelter it. Over time he bonded deeply with the Lunatone, whom he calls Branwen, and now seeks adventure with it. He has brown medium-length hair parted to the left, hazel eyes, a nicely trimmed beard, and defined, muscular arms.

Name: Crystal Lynn Hikari Tanzanaki
Age: Approximately 400+ years (exact age uncertain due to time distortion in Ultra Space)
Hometown: Alto Mare, Johto (also considers Alola home)
Short Description: A centuries-old Solgaleo hybrid traveler of Ultra Space who drifts between realities, observing each world before making herself known.
History: Originally from Alto Mare in Johto, Crystal eventually settled in Alola, where she spent her entire time as a Cosmog hybrid and her first six months as a Solgaleo hybrid. She has traveled through many different realities across Ultra Space in brief intervals and has not visibly aged despite existing for roughly four centuries. Cheerful but reserved, she typically observes a new world for several days before introducing herself, though she intervenes immediately if a major safety threat arises, and she seeks to leave memorable experiences with those she meets before departing to other realities.

Name: Alysandra "Aile" Wyndra
Short Description: A 28-year-old woman from Lumiose City, Kalos, who goes by "Aile."
History: (Marked as WIP in the profile; no backstory written.)

Name: Maximillian "Max" Fritz
Gender: Male (implied by pronoun use in profile; no gender field)
Short Description: A witty, easygoing electric-type specialist from Mauville City who left his quiet life behind to seek friends and adventure.
History: Max grew up near the power plant in Mauville City and gravitated toward electric-type Pokemon all his life, occasionally visiting his grandparents in Verdanturf Town while otherwise living a quiet, solitary life in a one-room house. After hearing recruitment stories about Team Cipher and Team Snagem, he donned his favorite coat and left his hometown to begin his journey in search of adventure and companionship. He travels with Cawber, a level-10 Murkrow. He avoids fights unless needed, is witty and quick, specializes in electric types, and fears dark caves and deserts.

Name: Jakob Hollway
Hometown: Hoenn region (birthplace); currently lives in Kalos
Short Description: A 17-year-old orphan from Hoenn, now living in Kalos, whose Cubone died in a fire only to return to life as a strange black, blue-flamed Marowak.
History: Jakob and his sister Jesse lost their parents in a fire in the Hoenn region and moved to live with their uncle in Kalos. Jakob's Cubone perished in the same fire, but unexpectedly evolved into a Marowak and returned to life. This Marowak has unusual characteristics — dark, almost black skin and a bone weapon shrouded in blue flames — and Jakob seeks help understanding this unprecedented phenomenon, having never heard of such an occurrence before.

Name: Jean Beaumont
Short Description: A 17-year-old foster runaway from Snowbelle City whose memory resets nightly after a childhood accident, accompanied by his service Absol, Ancil.
History: At age ten, while playing hide-and-seek with other foster children in the woods behind their home, Jean and the others hid in a cave occupied by a wild Beartic, which attacked and chased them; Jean, the slowest, was its main target, and an avalanche was triggered — his last clear memory. An Absol found him and dragged him to the hospital, where doctors discovered permanent brain damage causing permanent short-term memory loss: each night when he sleeps, his memory resets to the day before the accident. His foster parents returned him to the system, unable to manage his condition, and he bounced through unstable placements, some sincere and some exploitative. At seventeen he ran away from a particularly neglectful foster home, and after reaching a Pokemon Center with his service Absol Ancil, he overheard Snagem members and decided to join their organization, resonating with their ideals.

Name: Isaac Hawking
Short Description: A 24-year-old former repair-shop mechanic from Goldenrod City who joined Snagem after years of poverty, carrying his late father's oversized wrench and old motorcycle.
History: Isaac helped his father run a repair shop in Goldenrod City for many years until his father's death. He then lived in poverty for six years before leaving to join Snagem. He keeps an oversized wrench and an old motorcycle that belonged to his father.

Name: Katie
Short Description: A 14-year-old professor's daughter from Littleroot Town who left home to complete her Pokedex and train her Ralts.
History: Katie grew up in Hoenn with her father, a Pokemon professor, after her mother died in an accident, spending most of her childhood in his laboratory playing with Pokemon. On her seventh birthday her father gave her a Pokemon from his lab, and thanks to his work she has extensive Pokemon knowledge and can befriend any species she meets. Her goal is to complete her Pokedex to 100%, and she recently left home to explore the world and train her Ralts. She is struggling to overcome a traumatic encounter with male thugs who abused her and forced her to do things against her will, and she wears a mysterious stone from her father's laboratory as a necklace, believing it lucky.

Name: Alexander
Hometown: A forest full of hard-to-find Pokemon, often hunted by poachers
Short Description: A nineteen-year-old Crobat hybrid nicknamed "Lil' bat" who spent a decade living among forest Pokemon and deeply distrusts humans.
History: Alexander was born into a family of scientists with three elder sisters; when his parents' hybridization experiments killed their volunteer test subjects, they turned to their own children. His sisters died during experimentation, but nine-year-old Alexander survived the Crobat hybridization process, and after further experiments he escaped and collapsed in a forest, where Pokemon nursed him back to health. For ten years he lived among the forest Pokemon as their protector against poachers, growing to despise humans while understanding Pokemon communication well. A Zoroark hybrid named Nemi convinced him to join Team Snagem on the condition that they protect his forest home and Pokemon family. He is introverted and antisocial toward humans but accepting of other hybrids, enjoys sewing and crafting clothes, and fidgets around unfamiliar technology.

Name: Clara Devict
Short Description: A scientifically minded researcher, freshly doctored from Galar University, drawn back to Snagem by a mysterious Yamask wearing her late brother's helmet.
History: Clara is a scientifically minded researcher who recently earned her doctorate from Galar University; during her studies she released all her Pokemon, a decision she has kept secret. While visiting the grave of her brother Kain one winter, an elderly woman appeared and spoke with her about her late brother's pride and strength, then gave Clara a Poke Ball containing a Yamask (Echo) wearing her brother's helmet. This compelled Clara to return to Snagem to seek answers and reconnect with the community.

Name: Giovanni Versechi
Short Description: A 20-year-old trainer from Olivine City, raised by Gym Leader Jasmine after Team Rocket killed his mother, now carrying a mysterious Snag Machine in Kalos.
History: Gio was born and raised in Olivine City; his mother was killed by Team Rocket while protecting her Pokemon, which were also lost in the attack. Gym Leader Jasmine took him in, raised him, and let him work at her gym, but when a strong trainer defeated the gym, Jasmine left on her own journey and Gio followed. Reaching Kalos, he chose to stay for the scenery, returned Jasmine's loaned Pokemon, and began his independent journey. In a secluded Kalos location he discovered a Snag Machine along with an Absol and an empty Poke Ball, plus a note addressed to him instructing him to catch a Cipher Pokemon; following the instructions, he obtained his Tyrogue and continues his mission.

Name: Kaitlyn "Kate" Frezzo
Short Description: A 23-year-old hybrid from Floaroma Town in Sinnoh who, after losing both parents, drifted to Orre and joined Team Snagem.
History: Kate was an only child whose mother died when she was young, leaving her to be raised by her single father, nicknamed "Zilla" for his love of Croconaw-type Pokemon; their close bond gave her a sheltered, innocent outlook. Her father later died in a car accident on the way to Hearthome City. Kate relocated to Orre and became reclusive, occasionally returning to Sinnoh to catch and sell local Pokemon. On one such visit she learned of Snagem's revival, was drawn to the organization's darker aesthetic, and joined Team Snagem.

Name: Amity June Keller
Birthday: (exact date not stated; zodiac: Scorpio sun, Virgo moon, Libra rising)
Short Description: A freedom-loving 19-year-old drifter from Goldenrod City, nicknamed Keller, who travels alone with her Litwick, Flicker, favoring ghost, psychic, and dark types.
History: Amity grew up in a religious family on the poorer side of Goldenrod City, where her independent nature and love of dark-type Pokemon were treated as something dirty and bad. She frequently ran away, found her Litwick companion Flicker at age 13, and left home permanently a year later. Since then she has traveled alone with Flicker, taking odd jobs to afford food and cheap motels and moving through underground vagabond circles while avoiding lasting relationships. She recently joined Snagem, drawn to an organization fighting for beliefs she supports, though she maintains her independence. She is slow to anger, dislikes controlling people and being touched, enjoys spicy food and smoking, and is happiest in busy places where others ignore her; she is a lesbian, 115 lbs.

Name: Monique Kaʻanaʻana
Birthday: March 23 (born 2046 in her home timeline; listed as "1997")
Short Description: A former sheriff from a post-apocalyptic Alolan biodome town, now a Zoroark hybrid and unwitting "Faller" displaced 49 years into the past.
History: Monique was originally a human sheriff in the post-apocalyptic biodome settlement of New Po Town (Alola/U-369). She mysteriously transformed into a Zoroark hybrid and was transported 49 years into the past, arriving on the slopes of Mt. Silver. She initially had no memory of earlier events involving a Flower City explosion until an encounter with the Ultra Beast Stakataka restored those memories. Having traveled through an Ultra Wormhole as an unwitting "Faller," she draws the attention of Ultra Beasts, and she remains uncertain about controlling her Pokemon abilities, though she can occasionally project her human form via Illusion. She now works with Snagem while investigating her strange displacement.

Name: Rein Kisaragi
Short Description: A 17-year-old trainer from Nimbasa City, sole survivor of the fire that killed his family, driven by vengeance and a hatred of Cipher.
History: Rein grew up in Nimbasa City but found it boring and longed to explore; his sister frequently rode the ferris wheel. A cooking accident involving his father burned their house down, leaving Rein the sole survivor. He never knew his mother, but his father passed down the phrase "I am the alpha and omega, I will give unto him the waters of life." Afterward he attended Pokemon school to study type advantages and battle mechanics, competing in tournaments (5 wins out of 7 battles) and repeatedly clashing with a rival named Zane, a dragon-type trainer who hated Rein's family. After learning of Cipher through news reports, Rein came to hate the organization and resolved to fight for freedom and avenge those responsible for burning his home and family — a trauma that strengthened him but also left him "a little psychopathic."

Name: Aleissa "Night" Gauthier
Short Description: A black-and-red-furred Ninetales hybrid from Goldenrod with an extensive twelve-Pokemon team.
History: The profile states the background section is "currently being rewritten"; no backstory is available in the thread.

Name: Evelyn
Short Description: A 20-year-old Leafeon hybrid with lower-back-length green hair, daughter of a Flareon (Firenze) and a Jolteon (Blitzy), who favors organic food and green tea.
History: No dedicated backstory section is given in the profile. Stated family details: her mother is Firenze (a Flareon) and her father is Blitzy (a Jolteon). She weighs 115 lbs, has brown eyes, no allergies and no significant other, rarely touches meat and prefers organic food, favors green tea, the colors red/blue/green, and Psychic and Fire types.

Name: Sihlo S. Adonia
Short Description: A 19-year-old pierced-and-tattooed human trainer from Viridian City with a short black pixie cut fading to pink tips and a scar over her left eyebrow.
History: The profile states the background section is "currently being written"; no backstory is available in the thread. Her team consists of Atreyu (male Persian), Adema (female Zangoose), and Sabbath (male Purrloin).

Name: Mirepoix
Short Description: A 26-year-old human woman with long black hair streaked red, yellow, and blue, accompanied by a trio of female Eeveelutions (Na the Flareon, La the Jolteon, Gea the Vaporeon).
History: No History or backstory section is present in the profile; only physical characteristics (105 lbs, blueish-green eyes) and her Pokemon companions are listed.

Name: Lancaster
Short Description: A 21-year-old Alolan from Hau'oli who abandoned his Island Challenge to chase a life beyond the islands, going by the pseudonym Lancaster.
History: Kawika Waiwai'ole grew up in Hau'oli on Melemele Island in Alola, dreaming of experiences beyond island life. Disenchanted with local tradition, he abandoned his Island Challenge to pursue opportunities elsewhere, only to discover that life outside Alola has serious problems, including people completely disrupting the harmony between Pokemon and people. He travels with a Pyukumuku (Innards Out) and a Mimikyu. The profile marks further backstory as "more tba".

Name: Rexlena "Rexy" Williams
Short Description: A 15-year-old Poochyena hybrid orphan on the run since the group LORE killed her archeologist parents, guarded at first but fiercely loyal once trust is earned.
History: Rexy was born to archeologist parents who loved collecting unique items and artifacts. As a child they gave her two Pokemon — Venus, a Houndoom, and Shadow, a Mightyena — to keep her company while they were away. Around age twelve, a group called LORE killed her parents, and she has been on the run ever since. She eventually found a group with which she can at least have some shelter, though trusting others remains difficult. Initially anti-social and wary, she becomes nice, loyal, and warm once comfortable, though she tends to dwell on the past and sometimes slips into dark moods.

Name: Raimu Bito
Short Description: A 13-year-old shiny Pachirisu hybrid with the Volt Absorb ability, sister to Beat.
History: No backstory section is provided in the thread; the profile is a character sheet listing only basic data, her brother Beat, her ability (Volt Absorb), Pokemon roster, movesets, and inventory.

Name: Zwei Rose
Hometown: Kalos (family listed as "So. Many. Living in Kalos, near the Forest")
Short Description: A Yamper hybrid of unstated age from a very large family living in Kalos near the forest.
History: No backstory section is provided in the thread; the profile is a character sheet listing only basic data, his large family in Kalos, Pokemon roster, movesets, and inventory.

Name: Arciara Arctitus Stadanko-Valour
Short Description: A 20-year-old fighter from Violet City who defied her family's rigid gender traditions, trained in secret, and left home with her father's blessing.
History: Arciara was the firstborn of the Valour family, breaking a century-long tradition of male firstborns, and her father — mourning the son he had envisioned — initially rejected her. Raised in a household enforcing traditional gender roles (boys fight and train, girls keep house), she nonetheless showed natural strength and intelligence, and at twelve cut her hair short to reject feminine expectations. From fourteen to sixteen she secretly trained in combat and martial arts after her parents slept. At sixteen she encountered Team Snagem members and, drawn to their fighting abilities, went on to train formally under a Tower Monk, a Pokemon School Professor, and a martial artist until age eighteen. At nineteen she confronted her father about leaving Violet City; he confessed deep regret over neglecting her because of his disappointment about her gender, apologized, and gave her savings for the journey. She departed with her parents' blessing and family support.

Name: Alice Walker
Short Description: A 19-year-old former idol from Lumiose with honey-brown hair and a sylveon tattoo, who joined Snagem hoping to reform corrupt charities.
History: Alice grew up in a supportive household with caring parents. By age sixteen she had discovered talents in singing and dancing, which led to work as an idol. After attempting multiple charitable donations, she discovered corruption within the charity organizations she supported. Seeking to make positive change, she joined Snagem with hopes of reforming corrupted charities and making the world a little better. She travels with her male Eevee, Kazimir.

Name: Reno Vantas
Short Description: A 28-year-old street-raised thief with a Cockney accent who blasted his way out of servitude to a crime boss and into Team Snagem's ranks.
History: Reno was born on the streets and survived through theft. An attempt to steal from a crime boss backfired and resulted in forced servitude, during which he learned skills from fellow conscripts and picked up his Cockney accent. He eventually escaped with stolen Pokemon, deliberately releasing most of them except a Shellder that clamped onto his hand. Team Snagem recruited him after hearing of his destructive escape.

Name: Leslie
Short Description: A 15-year-old girl abandoned by her mother, who survived on the streets caring for her injured sister before being taken in at Snagem HQ.
History: Leslie was born to Kairi's mother and an unknown father. Her mother abandoned her, and Leslie cared for her injured sister while living on the streets. She was later rediscovered by Kairi, revealing their sibling relation. After recovering, she relocated to Snagem HQ with her sister.

Name: Aria Glissando
Short Description: A 25-year-old Kalosian musician who built a Pokemon musical ensemble and sailed to Kanto seeking fame.
History: Aria started her trainer journey at age 9 after getting lost near Parfum Palace, where a Pancham found her and became her first Pokemon. She later shifted to a music career, using a Noibat as an amplifier and building a musical ensemble with an Inkay and Pangoro. She moved to Kanto seeking popularity, but faced being undercut by competition and boarded the S.S. Anne.

Name: Beauregard Orson LeForrest
Short Description: A 30-year-old Vivillon hybrid from La Ruche turned hybrid-rights extremist and escaped prisoner.
History: Beauregard was raised in a divided environment and became separated from his family due to extremist views. Confronting Kalosian racism toward hybrids, he conducted terrorist attacks using explosives and a Seedot to promote hybrid equality. He was captured by guards and imprisoned until an escape facilitated by an unknown cause.

Name: Sterling Grey
Short Description: A 23-year-old abbey-raised pilgrim turned choir founder who wandered Johto's sacred sites before joining Team Snagem.
History: Abandoned as an infant at Mt. Silver's Abbey of Saint Toge, Odd spent 15 years in spiritual training there. He departed to explore Johto's sacred sites, including Sprout Tower, the Ruins of Alph, and the Ilex Forest shrine, before settling in Sinnoh. There he discovered music and formed a church choir. Meeting Team Snagem member Toren redirected his path into the organization.

Name: Lykas-Terrynce Fenrral
Short Description: A leap-day-born human/Jellicent hybrid, son of Gym Leader Wallace, who fled a sheltered upbringing to find independence with Snagem.
History: Terry is the son of Gym Leader Wallace and was raised by Kanto's Gym Leader Erika due to his hemophilia. His sheltered upbringing caused growth delays. At age 14 he escaped to find independence, and he eventually joined Snagem after meeting his hybrid companion Varuna.

Name: Wren Briony
Short Description: A 35-year-old master gardener and rancher from Lentimas Town who turned his green thumb into a flower and fertilizer trade.
History: Wren's impoverished childhood was transformed through his gardening expertise; by age 12 his vegetable garden was enriching his community. At 15 he set out to see Professor Juniper but instead encountered an injured Maractus, which became his starter Pokemon. He spent roughly 20 years managing a Cacnea ranch before returning home to establish flower commerce and fertilizer production.

Name: Clare Asmia Kristel
Short Description: A gentle, curious human/Nihilego hybrid from Ultra Space whose memories were shattered by the crossing.
History: Clare arrived with fragmented memories of a dark city and a prior group affiliation involving a SNAG device. Travel through Ultra Space left her with amnesia. Despite her fear of the unknown, her personality centers on gentleness and curiosity.

Name: Sheeta Melian
Short Description: A 14-year-old orphan from Mahogany Town who finally pursued her long-held dream of joining Snagem.
History: Sheeta lost her parents when they died in an accident. This tragedy became the catalyst for her to pursue a long-held aspiration to join Snagem, an organization she had previously been unable to join due to family obligations. With her parents gone, she pursued membership by meeting the organization's requirements. She travels with her Inkay, Squiddles, and a Ditto named Morph.

Name: Chiara Marzo
Short Description: An energetic, optimistic 16-year-old runaway from Dendemille Town with a knack for calming difficult Pokemon.
History: Chiara grew up in chilly Dendemille Town alone with her mother after her father, a former trainer from Unova, abandoned the family when she was young, leaving behind a Minccino named Latte intended as her future companion. Her mother blamed Chiara for the abandonment and treated her harshly to cope with her own pain. At sixteen, following a serious conflict at home, Chiara ran away, taking Latte with her. She resolved to build a better life by traveling, meeting new people, and helping others, mirroring her father's path as a trainer, and hoped to eventually reunite with him.

Name: Sub
Short Description: A 27-year-old dark channeler from Ecruteak City known as "The Dark One," with an extensive Pokemon roster and cousin to Toren.
History: No written backstory is provided in the profile. The profile instead documents his dark channeling abilities (Dark Touch, Forbidden Corridor, Raven's Rapping, Mal Reversal, Tamerlane's Glory), an extensive roster of over 35 caught Pokemon, items, and Mega Stones. He is listed as the cousin of fellow member Toren.

Name: Toren Winchester Manfield
Short Description: A 17-year-old steel-type specialist from Violet City and cousin of Sub.
History: The profile's bio section is marked "Coming soon" and no backstory is provided. He is listed as Sub's cousin, carries a Pokegear V2 and Go-Goggles, and fields a team of steel-type Pokemon including Metagross, Steelix, and Forretress.

Name: Larrimore
Short Description: A towering 23-year-old Pinsir hybrid from La Ruche who carries a wooden sword.
History: The profile's bio section is marked "Coming soon" and no backstory is provided. He carries a Holocaster and a wooden sword, and his team consists of Chesnaught, Pineco, and Vespiquen.

Name: Fenrir Ragnarok
Short Description: An aggressive, cocky 18-year-old Channeler from Unova whose hard-won bond with his Axew earned him a place in Team Snagem.
History: Fenrir was an energetic, joyful child until a transformative event altered his personality, leaving him with an aggressive, cocky demeanor mirroring his first Pokemon partner, Axew. The dragon-type initially did not reciprocate his feelings, but after an intense conflict in which Fenrir pinned Axew during their struggle, a powerful bond formed between them. The rebellious duo caught the attention of a high-ranking Team Snagem officer who witnessed their strength in battle and invited them to join the organization.

Name: Terashi Neil Toumei
Short Description: A 29-year-old Castelia-born Snagem veteran, husband to Keiko and father of the Toumei daughters.
History: Terashi was born in Castelia City to a Silph Co. employee and his trophy wife. He attended the Pokemon Trainer's School in Viridian City for four years and then Kanto Academy for five, receiving a custom Pokedex and a starter Oshawott upon graduation. He joined Team Snagem and later traveled Unova collecting gym badges, but was ambushed by Cipher grunts on Route 3 and spent a year in a coma. Upon recovery he rejoined Team Snagem. He married Keiko and has two biological daughters, Yuna and Serena, plus an adopted daughter, Ulla.

Name: Keiko Yuniko Toumei
Character Species: Human (later transformed into Shiny Lopunny hybrid)
Short Description: A 31-year-old orphan turned Snagem member, hybridized into a Shiny Lopunny form, and wife of Terashi.
History: Keiko was an orphan raised by elderly operators of a delivery service south of Tohjo Falls. Lost while attempting a delivery to the Indigo Plateau, she was attacked by a wild Tentacruel and rescued by Lykas and Odd, after which she joined Team Snagem. She previously dated Aluette Renarde, and later fell for Terashi after he saved her from a giant Victreebel. Separated from him during the Route 3 attack, she returned to her adoptive family in guilt, reuniting with Terashi a year later while helping rout Pokemon thieves. She was abducted by Lovrina and hybridized into a Lopunny form, then married Terashi and bore their daughter Yuna.

Name: Absinthe Deathrage
Short Description: A 16-year-old from Goldenrod City, taken in by Chaos and Eve, who joined Team Snagem to find her path in life.
History: Absinthe was kicked out of her biological mother's house in Hoenn. She approached Chaos in Goldenrod City and, after proving her parentage, was taken in by Chaos and Eve. She attended the Pokemon Trainer's School in Viridian City with support from Eve and her adopted brother Lykas, and joined Team Snagem to determine her life path.

Name: Yuna Toumei
Short Description: The toddler firstborn daughter of Terashi and Keiko, born at Snagem HQ.
History: Yuna was born to Terashi and Keiko following their Alola honeymoon, with her parents isolating in Sinjoh during the pregnancy. She was delivered with the assistance of Doc Owl. She suffered night terrors in her first year tied to hybrid complications, which were resolved through child therapy.

Name: Serena Toumei
Short Description: The infant second daughter of Terashi and Keiko, a peaceful sleeper born at Snagem HQ.
History: Serena is the second biological daughter of Terashi and Keiko, conceived during a Kitakami trip. Keiko declined Sinjoh isolation this time and the pregnancy proceeded safely at Snagem HQ. Serena was born with Doc Owl's assistance and sleeps peacefully through the nights.

Name: Corinne Toumei
Short Description: Terashi's mother, an esper with the ability to detect emotional lies.
History: Corinne is Terashi's mother and the spouse of a Silph Co. employee. She possesses the esper ability "Emotional Lie Detection." She helped raise Terashi and believed Keiko was her long-lost daughter based on a burnt birth certificate.

Name: Aaron Toumei
Short Description: Terashi's father, a Silph Co. employee.
History: Aaron is Terashi's father and a Silph Co. employee. Through testing, he discovered that Keiko was not a biological member of the family.

Name: James Terrazen
Short Description: A side character listed as "The Limitbreaker," whose profile is still pending.
History: No profile exists yet; the thread lists him only as "The Limitbreaker: James Terrazen (Information pending)" under Side Characters.

Name: Royce Siegman
Short Description: A 22-year-old self-taught Pokemon medic from Mistralton City's airfields, recruited by Team Snagem for his healing skills.
History: Royce grew up in Mistralton City, Unova's cargo and shipping hub, where as a child he helped airfield workers by delivering water and lemonade before graduating to carrying a first aid kit. He found his calling at the local Pokemon Centre, tending injured Pokemon, particularly those hurt battling Gym Leader Skyla. When criminal groups including Team Plasma, Team Flare, and Team Aqua pressured local workers, Team Snagem intervened, drove off the criminals, and set up airstrip surveillance. Impressed by Royce's ability to treat their Pokemon without professional facilities, Snagem recommended him for recruitment.

Name: Sunday
Short Description: A veteran Snagem Official with 11 completed missions whose written backstory was never filled in.
History: The profile's story section contains only the placeholder "Story Goes Here Sometime," so no backstory is stated. The profile focuses on Sunday's standing as a Snagem Official with 11 completed missions and a Pokemon roster including Felez (obtained during Sunday's master mission and described as having an unsteady, on-and-off relationship with Sunday, currently missing in action), along with Desez and Isen, Felez's partner. The author later commented in 2014 that the profile reflected "teenage me."

Name: Allen Blake
Short Description: A street-smart 17-year-old thug from Cinnabar Island who ditched his scientist parents' academic expectations to become the perfect Grunt for Team Snagem.
History: Allen grew up the only child of scientist parents on Cinnabar Island but rejected their academic expectations, joining Team Snagem instead of going to college; his parents no longer speak to him over it. He received his starter Magby from a great uncle who breeds Magmortar, and was given his Koffing by a high-ranking Team Rocket member after initially clashing with the Pokemon. He caught a Clefairy legitimately at a Safari Contest, though it dislikes him, and caught a Gastly during a mission involving Jack and spirits from the Otherworld. Not book smart but sharp on the streets, he favors infiltration, sleight of hand, and trickery over brute force or charisma.

Name: Hudson Spooner Jr.
Short Description: A 19-year-old Celadon City "city boy" and ex-gang member who goes by his last name, Spooner, and is estranged from his family over his criminal past.
History: Spooner grew up in Celadon City, the son of Felecia, a secretary, and Hudson Spooner Sr., who managed the Celadon Mall; he considered himself vastly unoriginal growing up, with average grades, and picked up smoking early. He joined a local gang and later became a Team Rocket member before leaving; on leaving the gang he gave up his assigned Zubat, which he would forever miss. His criminal past left him estranged from his family, and former colleagues cut contact with him to protect their own criminal interests.

Name: Ulla Hanabi
Short Description: A young fairy Channeler from Iki Town, twice returned from death and blessed by Xerneas, who joined Team Snagem to save her stolen Riolu.
History: Ulla grew up in Iki Town surrounded by Pokemon; at age 8 she defended a Riolu from wild Pokemon with a stick, and the two became inseparable, wearing matching necklaces, later joined by a Rowlett. Days before her tenth birthday, strange men captured Riolu and turned it into a Shadow Pokemon; Ulla took Rowlett as her starter and searched until she found Riolu with the criminals at a Pokemon Center, where it partially broke free to protect her, and she was recruited into Team Snagem to help purify Riolu and stop future captures. Her mother, also a fairy channeler, had brought Ulla back from death as an infant; when her parents were murdered, that channeling died and Ulla died a second time, but her brother Leon begged Arceus for her return and Xerneas answered, blessing her with life. Her awakening channeling powers proved unstable, so Pokemon brought her to the Fairy Realm, where she spent two years training and studying to become a Guardian.

Name: Leon Hanabi
Short Description: Ulla's laid-back 20-year-old older brother, a poison Channeler who raised her after their parents' deaths.
History: Leon is the eldest Hanabi sibling; he lost his parents at age 10, when Ulla was 8 months old, and primarily raised her until she was 6. He then left on his Pokemon journey with his longest-held companion Roselia (originally a Budew), winning numerous gym battles but never pursuing a championship, and regularly returned home to visit Ulla and their parents' grave. Before leaving, he gave Ulla their mother's cherished necklace. He has a laid-back attitude and prefers relaxing in the grass and sunlight.

Name: Zane Belazarus
Gender: Male (implied by pronoun use in profile; no gender field)
Hometown: Geosenge Town in the Kalos region
Short Description: A 34-year-old loner from Geosenge Town who turned a lifelong hobby of researching the past into a hunt for the person behind his parents' deaths.
History: Zane's parents died in a fire that burned down his house when he was just a little kid. He lived alone for most of his life, with his hobby of researching the past being the only thing keeping him going. Wanting more, he set out on a journey to find the person behind his parents' death.
